natural: Practising calligraphy by the pond

meaning.zh: 比喻刻苦练习书法。

examples.zh: 他临池学书数十年，终成书法大家。
examples.en: After decades of diligent practice, he became a master calligrapher.

examples.zh: 临池学书需要耐心和恒心。
examples.en: Practising calligraphy takes patience and perseverance.

story.en: The Han calligrapher Zhang Zhi practised so much by a pond, washing his brush in it, that the water turned black. Wang Xizhi admired him for it.
story.zh: 王羲之说东汉张芝"临池学书，池水尽墨"。

natural: Talent shown by willow catkins

meaning.zh: 称赞女子有文才。

examples.zh: 她柳絮才高，诗词写得极好。
examples.en: She has brilliant literary talent and writes wonderful poetry.

examples.zh: 谢道韫柳絮才高，传为佳话。
examples.en: Xie Daoyun's literary gift became a celebrated tale.

story.en: One snowy day Xie An asked what the snow resembled. His nephew said "salt scattered in the air"; his niece Xie Daoyun said "better, willow catkins rising on the wind" — and was praised for her wit.
story.zh: 谢安问雪像什么，侄子说"撒盐空中差可拟"，侄女谢道韫说"未若柳絮因风起"，谢安大加赞赏。

natural: Losing again and again, fighting again and again

meaning.en: To keep fighting despite repeated defeats.
meaning.zh: 多次失败仍多次奋战。形容不屈不挠。

equivalents: fall seven times, stand up eight

examples.zh: 他创业屡败屡战，终于成功了。
examples.en: His businesses kept failing, but he kept going and finally succeeded.

examples.zh: 这支球队屡败屡战，精神可嘉。
examples.en: The team keeps getting back up — admirable spirit.

usage.en: Predicate. Often contrasted with 屡战屡败 (always losing); popularly attributed to Zeng Guofan rewording a report.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。常与"屡战屡败"对比，传说曾国藩改奏折用词。

pinyin: luó sī ké lǐ zuò dào chǎng
natural: Holding a Buddhist service inside a snail shell

meaning.en: To do something elaborate in a cramped space or with scant resources.
meaning.zh: 比喻在狭小的地方做复杂的事情。

equivalents: squeeze a quart into a pint pot

examples.zh: 这么小的房间要放这么多东西，真是螺蛳壳里做道场。
examples.en: Fitting so much into such a tiny room — squeezing a quart into a pint pot.

examples.zh: 预算这么少还要办大活动，等于螺蛳壳里做道场。
examples.en: Putting on a big event with this budget is making do with very little.

usage.en: Predicate or object. Originally a Shanghai/Wu saying.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语。源自吴语（上海话）。

natural: A blind man on a blind horse

meaning.zh: 盲人骑着瞎马。比喻处境极其危险。

examples.zh: 没有经验又不做调研就投资，无异于盲人瞎马。
examples.en: Investing with no experience or research is flying blind.

examples.zh: 他们盲人瞎马地闯进了沙漠。
examples.en: They rushed blindly into the desert.

story.en: In a game of describing danger, someone said: "A blind man riding a blind horse, approaching a deep pool at midnight."
story.zh: 《世说新语·排调》中众人作"危语"，有人说："盲人骑瞎马，夜半临深池。"

natural: Blankly uncomprehending

meaning.zh: 完全不了解。

examples.zh: 他的解释让我更加茫然不解。
examples.en: His explanation left me even more baffled.

examples.zh: 看着复杂的说明书，老人茫然不解。
examples.en: Looking at the complicated instructions, the old man was at a loss.

natural: Plum, orchid, bamboo and chrysanthemum

meaning.en: The "Four Gentlemen" of Chinese art, symbolising noble virtues.
meaning.zh: 被称为"四君子"，象征高洁的品格，是中国画常见题材。

examples.zh: 梅兰竹菊被称为花中四君子。
examples.en: Plum, orchid, bamboo and chrysanthemum are called the Four Gentlemen of flowers.

examples.zh: 他擅长画梅兰竹菊。
examples.en: He's skilled at painting the Four Gentlemen.

usage.en: Noun phrase. Plum = resilience in winter, orchid = refinement, bamboo = integrity, chrysanthemum = reclusive purity.
usage.zh: 名词性。梅傲雪，兰幽雅，竹有节，菊淡泊。

natural: Gate and courtyard cold and deserted

meaning.zh: 门前和院子里冷冷清清。形容来客稀少。

examples.zh: 他退休后门庭冷落。
examples.en: After retiring, hardly anyone visits him.

examples.zh: 这家店门庭冷落，快要关门了。
examples.en: The shop is deserted and about to close.

natural: Densely packed

meaning.zh: 形容又多又密。

examples.zh: 笔记本上写得密密麻麻。
examples.en: The notebook is crammed with writing.

examples.zh: 广场上站满了密密麻麻的人。
examples.en: The square was packed with people.

usage.en: Attributive or complement. An idiomatic AABB.

natural: One's name resounding everywhere

meaning.zh: 名声一下子变得很大。

examples.zh: 他凭借一部电影名声大噪。
examples.en: He shot to fame with one film.

examples.zh: 这家小店因网络视频名声大噪。
examples.en: The little shop became famous thanks to an online video.

natural: Grinding an iron pestle into a needle

meaning.zh: 把铁棒磨成针。比喻有恒心肯努力，做任何事情都能成功。

equivalents: where there's a will there's a way

examples.zh: 只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针。
examples.en: With enough effort, even an iron rod can be ground into a needle.

examples.zh: 学习要有磨杵成针的毅力。
examples.en: Learning takes the persistence to grind iron into a needle.

story.en: Legend says the young Li Bai, giving up on study, met an old woman grinding an iron pestle. She said she was making a needle. Inspired, he returned to his books.
story.zh: 相传李白少年时逃学，遇见一位老妇人在磨铁杵，说要把它磨成针。李白深受感动，回去发奋读书。

usage.en: Predicate. Often 只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说"只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针"。

natural: Vision as small as a bean

meaning.zh: 眼光像豆子那样小。形容目光短浅，缺乏远见。

examples.zh: 他目光如豆，只看眼前利益。
examples.en: He's short-sighted and only sees immediate gains.

examples.zh: 做企业不能目光如豆。
examples.en: Running a business, you can't be blinkered.

natural: No longer seeing the whole ox

meaning.en: Consummate skill; seeing through to a thing's structure.
meaning.zh: 眼中没有完整的牛，只有牛的筋骨结构。形容技艺纯熟。

examples.zh: 他修车多年，已目无全牛。
examples.en: After years fixing cars, he knows them inside out.

examples.zh: 经验丰富的医生看病目无全牛。
examples.en: Experienced doctors see straight to the problem.

story.en: Cook Ding said that after three years of carving oxen, "I no longer saw the whole ox" (未尝见全牛也) — only the joints and gaps.
story.zh: 庖丁说："始臣之解牛之时，所见无非牛者。三年之后，未尝见全牛也。"

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

natural: Harder than climbing to heaven

meaning.zh: 比登天还难。形容极其困难。

examples.zh: 要他认错，难于登天。
examples.en: Getting him to admit he's wrong is next to impossible.

examples.zh: 在这座城市买房难于登天。
examples.en: Buying a home in this city is a tall order.

story.en: Li Bai's "Hard Roads to Shu": "The road to Shu is hard — harder than climbing to the blue sky!" (蜀道之难，难于上青天).
story.zh: 李白《蜀道难》："蜀道之难，难于上青天！"

natural: Chewing snow and swallowing felt

meaning.en: To endure extreme hardship while staying loyal.
meaning.zh: 形容在恶劣环境中坚守节操，不屈服。

examples.zh: 苏武啮雪吞毡，坚守汉节十九年。
examples.en: Su Wu chewed snow and swallowed felt, staying loyal to Han for nineteen years.

examples.zh: 他以啮雪吞毡的精神坚持下来。
examples.en: He endured with unwavering loyalty through every hardship.

story.en: The Han envoy Su Wu, imprisoned by the Xiongnu without food, survived by eating snow mixed with felt from his rug. He refused to surrender and herded sheep for nineteen years.
story.zh: 苏武出使匈奴被扣，被囚于地窖不给饮食，他"啮雪与旃毛并咽之"，坚持不降，牧羊十九年。

natural: Clinging to the shafts and lying in the ruts

meaning.en: (Of the people) begging a good official to stay.
meaning.zh: 拉住车辕，躺在车道上。形容百姓挽留好官。

equivalents: beg a beloved official to stay

examples.zh: 县令离任时，百姓攀辕卧辙，依依不舍。
examples.en: When the magistrate left, the people clung to his carriage, reluctant to let him go.

examples.zh: 他深受爱戴，调走时乡亲们攀辕卧辙。
examples.en: He was so beloved that villagers begged him to stay when he was transferred.

story.en: When the good governor Hou Ba was recalled, the people "wept and wailed, clinging to the carriage shafts and lying in the ruts" to keep him.
story.zh: 侯霸被征召离任，百姓"老弱相携号哭，遮使者车，或当道而卧"。

natural: Smashing a jar that's already cracked

meaning.en: To give up entirely after a setback; not care anymore.
meaning.zh: 比喻有了缺点、错误不改正，任其发展，或故意向更坏的方向发展。

equivalents: might as well be hanged for a sheep as a lamb

examples.zh: 考砸了一次就破罐子破摔，太不应该了。
examples.en: Giving up completely after one bad exam is wrong.

examples.zh: 别破罐子破摔，还有机会。
examples.en: Don't give up on yourself — there's still a chance.

usage.en: Predicate. Colloquial; 子 is neutral in speech (zi).

synonyms: 虱子多了不痒，债多了不愁

natural: Burning husks for light

meaning.zh: 点燃糠秕照明读书。形容家贫刻苦学习。

examples.zh: 古人然糠照薪，刻苦攻读。
examples.en: Ancient scholars studied by the light of burning husks.

examples.zh: 他家境贫寒，有然糠照薪的精神。
examples.en: From a poor family, he studied with tremendous dedication.

story.en: The scholar Gu Huan was so poor he read at night by the light of burning pine knots or rice husks.
story.zh: 顾欢家贫，夜间"然松节读书，或然糠自照"。

natural: The man and his zither both gone

meaning.en: Deep grief at the death of a loved one.
meaning.zh: 形容看到遗物，怀念死者的悲伤心情。

equivalents: grief for a lost loved one

examples.zh: 看到父亲的遗物，他感到人琴俱亡的悲痛。
examples.en: Seeing his father's belongings, he felt the pain of loss acutely.

examples.zh: 挚友去世，令人有人琴俱亡之痛。
examples.en: His close friend's death brought heartbreaking grief.

story.en: When Wang Xianzhi died, his brother Wang Huizhi took his zither and tried to play it, but it was out of tune. He threw it down: "Zijing, Zijing — man and zither both are gone!"
story.zh: 王献之死后，王徽之取其琴弹，琴弦不调，掷地叹道："子敬子敬，人琴俱亡！"

natural: Humble status, little power

meaning.zh: 地位低，权力小。

examples.zh: 我人微权轻，帮不上什么忙。
examples.en: I have little clout, so I can't be much help.

examples.zh: 他人微权轻，说话没人听。
examples.en: He has no clout, so no one listens.

natural: The sun is near, Chang'an is far

meaning.en: A cherished goal remains out of reach; homesickness for the capital.
meaning.zh: 比喻向往帝都而不得至，也比喻功名难成或理想难以实现。

examples.zh: 他屡试不第，常叹日近长安远。
examples.en: Failing the exams repeatedly, he often lamented his distant dream.

examples.zh: 离梦想看似很近，却总是日近长安远。
examples.en: The dream seems close, yet always stays just out of reach.

story.en: The young Emperor Ming of Jin was asked whether the sun or Chang'an was farther. First he said Chang'an was nearer — people come from there; next day he said the sun — "I can see the sun but not Chang'an."
story.zh: 晋明帝幼时，元帝问他长安与太阳哪个远，他先说太阳远，第二天又说："举目见日，不见长安。"

natural: Entering the room and taking up its spear

meaning.en: To refute someone using their own arguments.
meaning.zh: 到他的屋里，拿起他的武器攻击他。比喻引用对方的论点来反驳对方。

examples.zh: 他入室操戈，用对方的数据驳倒了对方。
examples.en: He turned their own data against them.

examples.zh: 这篇论文入室操戈，批驳很有力。
examples.en: The paper refutes the theory with its own arguments, very effectively.

story.en: When the scholar Zheng Xuan refuted He Xiu's works using He's own reasoning, He Xiu sighed: "Kangcheng has entered my room, taken up my spear and attacked me!"
story.zh: 郑玄用何休的观点反驳何休，何休叹道："康成入吾室，操吾矛，以伐我乎！"

synonyms: 以其人之道，还治其人之身

natural: Nourishing things silently

meaning.en: Quiet, subtle influence (especially of good teaching).
meaning.zh: 细雨悄无声息地滋润万物。比喻潜移默化地影响人。

examples.zh: 好的教育润物无声。
examples.en: Good education works quietly but profoundly.

examples.zh: 母亲的爱润物无声，影响了我一生。
examples.en: My mother's love quietly shaped my whole life.

story.en: Du Fu's "Happy Rain on a Spring Night": "It steals into the night on the wind, moistening things finely, without a sound" (随风潜入夜，润物细无声).
story.zh: 杜甫《春夜喜雨》："随风潜入夜，润物细无声。"

usage.en: Predicate. Common about teachers and parents.

natural: Keenly determined to forge ahead

meaning.zh: 意志坚决地追求进步。

examples.zh: 这位年轻的厂长锐意进取，大胆改革。
examples.en: The young factory manager is driven and boldly reforming.

examples.zh: 我们要锐意进取，开拓创新。
examples.en: We must forge ahead and innovate.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Formal; speeches and reports.
